verdict.rationale: telli documents a dedicated data retention feature that automatically deletes contacts and call data once they reach a user-defined age, which directly lets users control retention and deletion. The evidence for it is a single first-party docs line with no further detail. Missing for 10: on-demand or manual deletion of individual records, API-based deletion endpoints, granular retention settings per data type (e.g., recordings vs. transcripts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
